name: Clinton Health Access Initiative
summary: Works with governments to lower the cost and improve the delivery of medicines, tests and health services.

spending.source: https://www.clintonhealthaccess.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Clinton-Health-Access-Initiative-Inc.-2025-Short-Form-FS-Final.pdf (consolidated statement of activities, year ended 31 December 2025, p.4: programme services $259,345,003 of total expenses $289,354,222)

lines.label: Community-based TB case finding, India
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/clinton-health-access-initiative-tuberculosis-household-contact-management-june-2024 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): TB household contact management, India, Jun 2024, $15,092,329.

lines.label: Program performance management (organisational grant, not ranked)
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/clinton-health-access-initiative-chai-program-performance-management-grant-october-2024 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): Oct 2024, $5,104,824 for CHAI's program performance management (PPM) team, an organisational grant, not TB care through private providers. Its BOTEC values improvements across the CHAI programs the team influences, not one program's outcomes, so it doesn't count: weight 0, and its money is not moved to another program.

lines.label: ORS and zinc for diarrhoea
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/clinton-health-access-initiative-oral-rehydration-solution-zinc-bauchi-nigeria-september-2023 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): ORS and zinc, Bauchi, Sep 2023, $8,073,020.

lines.label: Technical support units
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/clinton-health-access-initiative-chai-technical-support-units-tsus-april-2025 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): technical support units, Apr 2025, $2,511,961.
